policy: Preserve six historical owner selections and their repeated multi-destination use
Do not treat artist/title string equality as physical-object identity without independent source references
External museum accession is not automatically the application's canonical registry ID
Photograph, crop and owner source preferences must be cleared independently

works.title: Entry of Christ into Jerusalem
works.institution: Indianapolis Museum of Art at Newfields
works.qualification: About 1617; same Commons file in both preserved Calendar/Palm Hero references. Do not conflate with Rubens Dijon Entry, or infer cropped/photograph release from public-domain painting.

works.title: The Great Day of His Wrath
works.qualification: 1851–1853 oil on canvas, part of Martin's triptych; both preserved relationships refer to same Commons Google Art Project file. Tate official page returned access denied in research browser, so accession is supported by referenced collection records rather than fetched institutional object text.

works.title: An Angel Frees the Souls of Purgatory
works.institution: Pinacoteca Vaticana (per WGA; institutional item not directly fetched)
works.qualification: Circa 1610, 44×51 cm; reportedly sketch for an altarpiece produced by Carracci workshop. Maintain attribution and institution accession hold, and do not present as an altar's complete version.
